message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.1.7 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

Version 2.1.7 redesigns the Auto Captions tab, brings back the UN-NEST button, fixes un-nesting nests that have audio, and fixes captions stopping after the first few seconds on the local engine.

*(Install over your current version with your ZXP installer and restart Premiere Pro once to apply the update.)*

♦️ **Redesigned Auto Captions Tab**
* **Four Clear Modes:** Captions, Word Pop, Transcript and Editor. Each mode shows only its own settings.
* **Engine & Models Drawer:** A compact chip shows your engine and credits. Local Whisper setup and models fold away while you use a cloud model.
* **One Action Bar:** The main button stays pinned at the bottom, with a live job card while captions are made.
* **Clearer Status:** Cancel now shows "Cancelled" instead of "Failed", the log opens again, and the panel no longer says "WORKING" when idle.

♦️ **Un-Nest Fixes (General tab)**
* **UN-NEST Is Back:** The button sits in a fixed slot and lights up when a nest is selected. It was hidden before.
* **Nests With Audio:** Un-nesting refused almost every nest that had audio. Nests at normal volume now un-nest correctly.

♦️ **Auto Captions Fix**
* **Captions for the Whole Clip (Local Engine):** With Hindi or Hinglish selected, local Whisper could stop after the first few seconds. The missing part is now transcribed and joined on, so captions run to the end of your clip.
